subject.title: feat: Add Anthropic server-side compaction API support

question: Should Anthropic-native compaction be exposed through provider-specific per-model parameters, through a new global `agents.defaults.compaction` mode, or remain unsupported until compaction ownership is unified?
rationale: Choosing the permanent public config owner and whether Anthropic or OpenClaw owns proactive compaction changes user-facing policy, compatibility, transcript behavior, and future provider symmetry.

options.title: Provider-owned model parameters
options.body: Add Anthropic-specific opt-in parameters at `agents.defaults.models["anthropic/…"].params`, preserve existing OpenClaw compaction defaults, and define typed continuation and fallback behavior in the Anthropic transport.

options.title: Global compaction mode
options.body: Add an Anthropic mode under `agents.defaults.compaction`, accepting a broader cross-provider configuration contract and its migration burden.

options.title: Keep unsupported
options.body: Continue relying on OpenClaw and plugin compaction until a provider-neutral native-compaction abstraction is designed.

recommendation.title: Provider-owned model parameters
recommendation.body: Add Anthropic-specific opt-in parameters at `agents.defaults.models["anthropic/…"].params`, preserve existing OpenClaw compaction defaults, and define typed continuation and fallback behavior in the Anthropic transport.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository identifies this account as lead maintainer, and the account already framed the config and continuation decisions for this issue.
